title: Launch roadmap tempo & risk lane — KPI compass
content:
Purpose:
This lightweight tracker blends a roadmap 'tempo lane' view with a launch-focused KPI compass and a concise risk lane. Intended for product ops + cross-functional launch owners to:
- communicate expected cadence and gating signals,
- surface the few metrics that determine go/no-go, and
- maintain a short actionable risk register that maps to owners.

How to use (1-page workflow):
- Weekly sync (Tues 10am): update tempo lane status + KPI snapshot.
- If any KPI hits a red threshold, trigger the triage play: engage SRE + Product + Eng leads within 30 minutes.
- Use risk lane to log mitigations and make a decision in the next daily standup.

Tempo lanes (by cadence)
- Sprint cadence (2w): feature staging, canary plan, e2e test pass. Owner: Priya Nair.
- Ramp cadence (days): staged traffic shifts (5%, 25%, 50%, 100%). Owner: Ravi Shah.
- Incident cadence (hours): rollback window, hotfix schedule. Owner: Tom Becker.

KPI compass (single-line tracker — snapshot each update):
Columns: Metric | Baseline | Target for Launch | Current | Trend | Threshold
1) 99th pct latency (ms) | 420ms | <= 450ms | 388ms | down | RED if >600ms
2) Mean token cost (USD/token) | 0.0009 | <= 0.0011 | 0.0010 | stable | RED if >0.0016
3) Error rate (5m average) | 0.7% | <=1.0% | 0.9% | up | RED if >2.5%
4) Successful canary requests (%) | N/A | 95%+ | 97% | stable | RED if <90%
5) Customer-visible defects | 0 | 0 | 1 (minor) | up | RED if >=3
6) Capacity headroom (GPUs) | 25% spare | >=10% spare | 18% spare | down | RED if <5%

Color policy (applied at row-level):
- GREEN: within target and stable for 24h
- AMBER: within 10–20% of threshold or trending toward it
- RED: threshold breached or >=2 amber signals in 6h

Gating criteria (go/no-go snippets):
- Go: All critical KPIs green OR exactly one amber with an approved mitigation and no reds.
- Hold: Any critical KPI red OR two ambers where mitigation is untested.
- Rollback: Customer-visible defect rate > threshold OR service error-rate sustained at red for 30m.

Risk lane (short register — max 6 active items):
- R1: Canary eviction under high-load (owner: Ravi) — mitigation: reserve burst capacity, pre-warm KV caches. Status: mitigation staged.
- R2: Quantization quality regression (owner: Priya) — mitigation: canary against golden promptset; gated deploy. Status: monitoring.
- R3: Unexpected billing spike (owner: Finance ops - Tom) — mitigation: token caps + automated throttle. Status: contingency ready.
- R4: Regional outage dependency (owner: Eng infra - Alex M.) — mitigation: route to alt-region; test DR runbook. Status: needs test.

Decision matrix (who signs off):
- Product PM (final feature readiness) = Priya Nair
- Eng lead (runtime readiness) = Ravi Shah
- SRE (SLO/capacity) = Tom Becker
- Ops/Customer Success (customer comms) = Lina Gomez
- Legal / Security (if PII/data risk) = Ignacio Ruiz (as needed)

Readiness checklist (quick yes/no for go):
- [ ] Feature tests green (unit + integration)
- [ ] Canary pass >95% success at 5% traffic for 2h
- [ ] Latency SLOs observed for 24h in staging
- [ ] Cost estimator validated and throttle set
- [ ] Rollback + hotfix runbook published and assigned
- [ ] Customer comms draft ready + legal review if required
- [ ] Monitoring dashboards up and alerting smoke test complete

Playbook snippets (if amber/red):
- Amber: Run targeted load test for the specific scenario, tag the failing traces, escalate to runtime team, schedule a 1-hour deep-dive.
- Red: Immediate traffic hold at ramp boundaries, engage incident manager, open incident doc, notify top-10 impacted customers via CS.

Sample notes from last sync (log):
- 2026-02-18: Canary hit 92% success at 5% due to timeout in edge pool; mitigation applied (pre-warm) and re-run — passed.
- 2026-02-20: Latency trending up during large batch jobs; action: shift background batch windows, re-evaluate kernel selection.

Next steps (this doc):
- Finalize runbook steps and attach to PR (assigned: Ravi; due: 2026-02-24).
- Run a DR routing test with alt-region (owner: Alex; due: 2026-03-03).
- Approve customer-facing comms (owner: Lina; draft linked above).

Notes to self / open questions:
- Do we need a secondary cost throttle per-customer for early adopters? (raise in PM sync)
- Consider adding an automated canary rollback when error-rate spikes >1.5% for 10m.

Bottom line: keep the tracker to a single page during launch windows — surface only the few metrics that change decisions. Use the risk lane as a short-lived working list (close items aggressively).
